title: Collapse routine informational Engram control cards (Turn admitted, Turn checkpointed) by default in the transcript; keep errors, warnings and action-required cards expanded
outcome: In the session transcript, routine informational Engram control cards render collapsed by default, so they don't crowd the conversation. Examples are DISPATCH "Turn admitted" and CHECKPOINT "Turn checkpointed" on a successful grant. Errors, warnings, refusals and any card that requires user action stay expanded and visible by default. A collapsed card can still be expanded on demand. No card is hidden or lost.
acceptance: Routine successful Engram control cards (for example DISPATCH 'Turn admitted' and CHECKPOINT 'Turn checkpointed' for a grant) render collapsed by default and expand on user action; covered by Vitest component tests.

Engram control cards that report an error, warning, refusal, waiting/unknown/paused/held state or a required user action render expanded by default; covered by Vitest tests, including at least one per category.

Existing transcript behaviour (loss and authority rendering, ordering, accessibility of the expand control) is unchanged; `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, the affected Vitest suites pass, and an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
